newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical Sciences says FDA gives ok.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical Sciences says FDA gives ok.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said Tuesday that it has recieved marketing approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its externally worn SKAR KARE product.
Life Sciences said the silicone based scar management device is scheduled for commercial launch in Europe and the U.S. in the fourth quarter of this year.

The company said in a statement that it has filed for a U.S. patent and will seek protection in other world markets. The company added that it believes the worldwide market for scar treatment products is estimated to be between $15 and $20 million annually, with room to grow.
